paragraphs: Emerge Knowledge sells Re-TRAC, a cloud-based platform for collecting, managing, and reporting materials management data. The company presents it as a suite meant to centralize reporting, simplify data management, and improve data quality.

One module pulls together data from landfills, material recovery facilities, transfer stations, and composting facilities in a single place. A hauler reporting module centralizes the permit application process, tracks pick-ups, monitors collection costs, and calculates greenhouse gas emissions. Another is aimed at grantmaking and other funding initiatives. A further module is described as reducing the administrative burden of monitoring compliance with commercial, multi-family, and construction and demolition recycling ordinances.

Several of these solutions are listed as a best fit for counties and regional government agencies. The company states that Re-TRAC is SOC 2 Type II compliant. It also claims decades of experience in this field. Buyers whose needs fall outside the packaged modules are invited to schedule a free consultation to design something tailored to their own data collection needs.

quote.text: Re-TRAC™ is a cloud-based platform that helps organizations collect, manage, and report materials management data.
